//: Extra permissions for a Java repository built with Gradle (see examples/project/.ai-flow/permissions.json for how this file is used). TEST_CMD is allowed as a prefix, so the agents can narrow a run with --tests <class>. For Maven, replace the two gradlew lines with "Bash(../mvnw -B -f ../pom.xml test:*)" (narrowed with -Dtest=<class>) and "Bash(../mvnw --version)". Never allow java bare, jshell, or docker (make check rejects them), nor a command that keeps running such as bootRun or spring-boot:run. The deny line is for local settings with passwords (Spring Boot's application-local.yml); name the files your project actually has.
